units: Ḥull. 45ᵇ נתמסמס פסול נ׳ כשר if the spinal cord is a pulpy mass, the animal is unfit, if merely softened, it is fit for food (Kasher).

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:1">Tosef. ib. III, 1</cite> <he>שנִתְמַזְמְזָה מוחה</he> an animal whose brain is softened; quoted Ḥull. l. c. <he>בהמה שנתמזמז וכ׳</he>, and corrected into <cite ref="M01962"><he>נתמסמס</he></cite>. Ib. (in Chald. dict.) <he>נ׳ מוחיה דדין</he> this man’s brain is softened.
